title: RTX to Raise Tomahawk, AMRAAM, SM-6 and SM-3 IB Output 2-4x Under Contracts Worth About $70 Billion
excerpt: RTX CEO Chris Calio said four multiyear Pentagon contracts worth about $70 billion will let Raytheon raise Tomahawk, AMRAAM, SM-6 and SM-3 IB production by two to four times.
rank_math_title: RTX $70 billion Tomahawk, AMRAAM, SM-6, SM-3 IB contracts | Envanter Medya
